q3_novel_expansion: Integrate memory-mapped files (mmap) allowing zero-copy persistence shared across independent OS processes.
Apply vector embedding indexing to state transactions for semantic similarity query retrieval.
q1_inquest: What happens if the system encounters an unexpected power loss or process crash before in-memory state is flushed?
How is cache coherence guaranteed when multiple parallel sub-agents update the memory pool concurrently?
What is the upper bound on memory consumption when processing millions of transactions under heavy load?

implementation_directives: Author mmap engine in Rust or Go for deterministic memory safety.
Maintain append-only transaction ledger in .state/ledger/ as ultimate ground truth.
q4_aligned_synthesis.consensus_verdict: Elevate from naive in-memory cache to Hybrid Memory-Mapped Write-Ahead Log (WAL) with LRU eviction.

q2_controversy_and_flaws.controversy: Pure in-memory caching without a write-ahead log introduces high risk of catastrophic data loss.
q2_controversy_and_flaws.hardened_alternative: Implement Write-Ahead Logging (WAL) with append-only ledger on NVMe SSD, keeping an in-memory index for 100k+ reads/sec with zero loss on crash.

q2_controversy_and_flaws.controversy: Unbounded memory cache can trigger Out-Of-Memory (OOM) killer terminations in containerized environments.
q2_controversy_and_flaws.hardened_alternative: Enforce LRU eviction policy with hard memory cap and deterministic paging to disk.

target_insight: Transition from file-based state ledger to distributed SQLite in-memory
